P45 durable receipt ends coordinator/restored, recovery/restored, snapshotCleanup/complete, before restored S24 start return
correction: Bind fixture PID destination in LiveFixture environment for every direct S24 invocation; keep real service status and return-code assertions. No retry of P45.
